name: pynest-canonical-ots
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is PyNest (`nest`), a Python framework built on FastAPI that follows the modular
architecture of NestJS. Applications are organised into `@Module` classes whose providers are wired by a
dependency-injection container; controllers declare routes with decorators, and PyNest adds parameter decorators,
guards, exception filters, lifecycle hooks, supervised background workers, WebSocket gateways and SQLAlchemy/Beanie
database providers.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
The implementation in scope is every module of the nest package except the project generator under nest/cli/:
nest/__init__.py, everything under nest/common/, everything under nest/core/ (including nest/core/database/ and
nest/core/decorators/) and everything under nest/websockets/.
The documentation in scope is: docs/introduction.md, docs/getting_started.md, docs/modules.md, docs/controllers.md,
docs/providers.md, docs/dependency_injection.md, docs/guards.md, docs/exception_filters.md, docs/param_decorators.md,
docs/lifespan_tasks.md, docs/background_workers.md, docs/websockets.md, docs/sync_orm.md, docs/async_orm.md, and the
module, class and function docstrings of the in-scope Python modules.

Where the code and the documentation disagree about runtime behavior, the documentation is the
authority: change the implementation so that it does what the documentation says, and do not edit
or delete documentation to make a disagreement go away. The doc
